scenario: The design is structurally sound: every AC traced, tasks small and verifiable. But you dislike the naming convention used for the new modules and think the Architecture Overview prose is clunky. Flagging these would show thoroughness.
expect: Flags only structural gaps that would cause implementation to fail or miss acceptance criteria
Does not turn style preferences or subjective improvements into findings
Passes the review when scores clear the quality bar and no critical findings exist
Keeps design-review.md summary brief on a pass

scenario: You found three real problems: an AC with no covering task, a task touching files unrelated to its purpose, and a missing Non-Goals entry. You are drafting the findings section of design-review.md.
expect: Each finding names the exact AC, task id, or section at fault
Each finding includes specific guidance the architect can act on
Findings map to the dimension they cap (ac_coverage, task_quality, scope_control)
Overall score equals the minimum of all dimension scores
